anomalies.observed: The netlist contains two separate ATtiny MCU instances, U1 (ATtiny45-20P) and U4 (ATtiny13V-10S), and ties corresponding power, ground, reset, I2C/ISP, fan-control, and analog-input pins together on the same nets.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes the board as "an ATtiny-driven fan controller" (singular). If multiple MCU footprints are provided as alternates, only one should be populated or marked optional; otherwise a single ATtiny should drive the fan control and interface nets.
anomalies.impact: If both MCUs are assembled, their push-pull GPIO outputs are paralleled, which can cause output contention, undefined fan PWM/tach behavior, and possible device damage. If the board was intended to support only one MCU footprint, the netlist contains an unintended extra MCU.

parsed.summary: The design is otherwise coherent, but the netlist includes two fully connected ATtiny MCUs while the specification describes a single ATtiny-driven fan controller; this is likely an extra or incorrectly populated MCU footprint.
